name: King's Metal Fiber Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: King's Metal Fiber Technologies Co., Ltd. is a Taiwan-based enterprise providing a variety of materials and specialized solutions. The company's primary offerings encompass thermal-resistant materials, particularly those integral to hollow glass formation and automotive glass blending. These products and services are supplied to diverse clients, including the glass manufacturing industry and the smart clothing retail sector. Operating from its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan, King's Metal Fiber Technologies also serves as a subsidiary of Tex-Ray Industrial Co., Ltd.
